method: Two ordinary pictures actually inspected alongside standard PMTiles. A court-level picture remains to inspect during construction; no bespoke research.

references.name: piazzale-porticos
references.observed: Roof/aerial picture actually inspected: complete two long parallel terracotta-roofed galleries, narrow open piazzale, transverse Arno-end range with visible central ground passage, irregular attached western/eastern roof blocks, skylights and a distinct octagonal Tribune roof with small pale/green lantern. Palazzo Vecchio is independent. Preserve the whole actual footprint and open street, not two isolated facade strips.

references.name: arno-serliana
references.observed: Arno facade actually inspected: three deep open ground arches with paired square/Doric supports and lateral column bays, long rectangular upper gallery windows below overhanging tiled eaves, a middle level of closed arched/rectangular timber-framed glazing, pale plaster and gray stone pilasters/cornices, side towers/returned ranges, river embankment below. Independent Palazzo Vecchio tower visible behind; do not add it to the Uffizi model. No copied statues, inscriptions or private decorative graphics.

references.name: ground-portico
references.observed: Actually inspected courtyard-level picture: true deep open flat-lintel colonnade, broad piers alternating with paired Doric columns, closed rear walls/doors, raised supported steps, dark gray stone trim andpale plaster panels, framed mezzanine windows, principal windows withalternating triangular/segmental pediments andsmall sill balusters, upper closed glazed gallery underdeep tiled eaves. Original empty niches, no copied statue meshes.
